response.text:
NextItNet’s causal dilated convolutions and residual paths provide natural intervention sites: block outputs, convolution branches, and temporal positions. Its receptive field establishes possible dependencies; it does not establish that a trained model uses distant history. The original [NextItNet paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/1808.05163) supports this architectural distinction. Searches found no directly matching NextItNet activation-patching study from 2024–2026; the strongest methodological matches concern language models.

Two 2024 papers provide transferable guidance. [Zhang and Nanda](https://arxiv.org/abs/2309.16042) show that corruption choices and evaluation metrics can substantially change localization results. [Heimersheim and Nanda](https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.15255) distinguish clean-to-corrupted restoration from corrupted-to-clean disruption; these provide different, intervention-dependent evidence about sufficiency and necessity. Component interactions and redundant paths limit conclusions from isolated patches. [AtP*](https://deepmind.google/research/publications/68553/) offers inexpensive gradient-based screening, but approximate attribution can miss components and should be followed by exact interventions.

Proposed adaptation, rather than a published NextItNet protocol: freeze each category’s single model; use a bounded sample and selected blocks. Compare histories preserving the final item while shuffling earlier nonpadding items against histories changing only the final item. Patch matched block/position activations in both directions; measure target-versus-negative score margins alongside validation ranking changes. Include identity/no-op patches, padding-only patches, and shuffled donor assignments matched for sequence length and endpoint. Keep evaluation mode and final-nonpadding readout fixed. Restoration above controls suggests localized temporal information use; endpoint-dominated effects alone do not establish harmful shortcut learning. Certify architectural locality separately by tracing actual dilation offsets, residual paths, padding, and normalization axes; empirical patch effects cannot certify dependency exclusion.
